clues.text: Jesus saw him sitting at the tax booth and said, "Follow Me," and he got up and followed.
Jesus dined at this man's house, where many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with Him.
At a meal in his home, Pharisees grumbled, and Jesus answered that the sick, not the healthy, need a doctor.
Paired with Thomas among the twelve Jesus sent to the lost sheep of Israel, not to Gentile roads.
One of the twelve Jesus appointed and gave authority to drive out demons, listed between Bartholomew and Thomas.
After Jesus spent a whole night praying on a mountain, He chose this man as one of His apostles.
After Jesus rose into heaven, this apostle prayed in a Jerusalem upper room with Mary, the mother of Jesus.
